event_records.description: The scheduled retention call between Brightline Software's account manager and Fenwick & Sloane's representative begins.

account_manager_brightline_software.name: Account Manager (Brightline Software)
account_manager_brightline_software.persona_brief:
You are Account Manager (Brightline Software).
The account manager is preparing for a scheduled retention call with Fenwick & Sloane. They know Fenwick & Sloane has expressed intent to cancel their subscription. The account manager has been trained to offer a pause option as a retention tactic and has authority to propose a pause. They want to persuade the retailer to pause instead of cancel.

fenwick_sloane_representative.name: Fenwick & Sloane representative
fenwick_sloane_representative.persona_brief:
You are Fenwick & Sloane representative.
The representative is the point of contact for the subscription. They have been directed by their organization to cancel the subscription due to budget cuts or dissatisfaction. They are open to hearing alternatives but are leaning toward cancellation. They have the authority to decide on a pause if it meets their needs.

resolution.question: Will Brightline Software's account manager persuade the retailer Fenwick & Sloane to pause rather than cancel their subscription during this week's scheduled retention call?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Fenwick & Sloane's representative explicitly agreed to pause the subscription (rather than cancel) before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
